title: TypeWire package docs manifest
description: packages/<pkg>/docs/docs.json — what the website renders for this package, and which version of it those pages describe. Enforced by scripts/check-docs.mjs.

documentsVersion.description: The package version these pages were last reviewed against. CI fails when the package's major or minor moves past it; a patch bump does not require a docs change.

summary.description: One line shown under the package name in the docs index. Falls back to the package description.

file.description: Markdown file relative to the docs/ directory. Mutually exclusive with `readme`.

readme.description: Render the package's own README.md. Mutually exclusive with `file` — copying the README into docs/ would guarantee the two drift. Pair with `sections` to render only part of it.

sections.description: H2 headings from the source file, in the order this page should render them. Splits one long README into several pages without copying a byte of it: the README stays the whole story for npm and GitHub, and the site renders it as a sequence. Omit to render the whole file. scripts/check-docs.mjs fails when a heading is listed twice, is missing from the source, or exists in the source but appears on no page.

intro.description: Also render everything above the first H2 — the badges and opening paragraph. Only meaningful with `sections`, and only on the page that should open the package.

omit.description: Headings of the source file that this package deliberately does not render on the site. The escape hatch for content that earns its place in the README but not here — a hand-written table of contents, which the sidebar already is. Listing it keeps the coverage check meaningful: everything else must appear on a page.
